name: AI Surf

sources.title: Homepage — 'Submit Tool' + 'Add Listing' nav links; 'Free Featured Badge' offer

conditions: Free path appears badge-linked — homepage offers a 'Free Featured Badge' that developers add to their own site; whether badge display is required for a free listing is unconfirmed
requirements: AI tools only — the directory is organized into ~30 AI categories (Art, Audio, Business, Chatbots, Code, etc.)
Submission requires a listing form reached via 'Submit Tool'/'Add Listing' nav links; guessed direct paths 404
Site runs WordPress + WPForms; submission form is JS-rendered behind the nav links
preparation: Tool name, URL, and category choice
Logo/screenshot likely requested by the WPForms listing form
workflow: Open https://theaisurf.com/ and click 'Submit Tool' (or 'Add Listing') in the header
Optionally add the 'Free Featured Badge' to the product site to qualify for featured placement
watchFor: Direct guessable submit URLs (/submit-tool/, /add-listing/) return 404 — entry is only via the nav links
Cloudflare challenge scripts are embedded site-wide; automated submission may be blocked
Free Featured Badge suggests a reciprocal-badge mechanic — verify whether it's required or optional before assuming a free dofollow listing
countsAsLive: The tool appears in a category listing on theaisurf.com under 'Just Added' or its category page
unknowns: Whether the free tier requires the badge
Whether the submit form is reachable for unauthenticated visitors end-to-end
